name: plan-and-execute
title: Break a question into steps, then answer it

comparison.purpose: A planner writes out the steps, each step is worked through in order, and a solver composes the final answer from what was gathered.

starters: Plan a 3-day food tour of Tokyo on a $200 budget.
Figure out how many tennis balls fit inside a school bus.
Work out whether a heat pump makes sense for a 1920s house.
